newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO police release seven PFLP-GC men in West Bank.
newsitem.headline: PLO police release seven PFLP-GC men in West Bank.

text.p: PLO police on Wednesday released seven leaders of a radical Palestinian group who were arrested in the West Bank six months ago, one of the detainees said.

"Although Palestinian authorities said we were arrested for security reasons, our detention stemmed from political reasons," said Hussam Arafat of the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine - General Command (PFLP-GC).
The PFLP-GC opposes the Israel-PLO peace deals signed since 1993.
At the time of their arrest, PLO officials said the seven men had threatened to kill President Yasser Arafat.
Palestinian intelligence services are still holding 12 PFLP-GC members in the West Bank, the group said.
